name: Cosmic Voyager
review:
A 10-line trip through space with wild scatters, expanding symbols and free spins that can retrigger. The book-style expanding symbol is the key: when it connects in the bonus, it can fill whole reels.

Very high volatility, 5,000x cap, 96.14% RTP. If you like the classic book format but want a sci-fi look, this one's worth a try.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
